name: Omastream
author: dhirajaryaa
description: Multi-platform live streaming studio for Omarchy & Arch Linux (YouTube, Twitch, Kick): multi-shape camera bubble (circle / 1:1 / 16:9) with drag and resize, plus a LIVE bar indicator that stops the stream on click.

barWidget.description: Red LIVE badge with uptime while omastream streams; click to stop, middle-click to toggle the camera bubble.
